purpose: Comprehensive twice-daily cross-fire observation over the combined Foundation + Operations family without creating a second authority.

authority.ai_execution: existing project-improvement-supervisor.yml and existing governed Operations provider runtime

cross_product.rule: Compare declared relationships pairwise/bounded across dimensions; missing edges become findings for the existing canonical owner.
cross_product.n2xn2: Use bounded declared cross-products, not unbounded combinatorial runtime execution.

ai.input: sanitized deterministic findings and live work metadata
ai.selection: existing governed provider runtime selects an eligible zero-cost provider using current capability, freshness, quota and cost state
ai.parallelism: eight deterministic observation lanes; existing AI supervisor chooses bounded remediation workflows

mutation.comments: only affected open PRs and changed finding states
mutation.pr_creation: only existing remediation workflows may create implementation branches/PRs

privacy.operations: raw private issue bodies and private source content stay inside the read-only family checkout
privacy.credentials: never serialized into reports, comments or AI context

non_authority: The scanner is descriptive governance telemetry. It must never replace source, test, runtime, production, policy, evolution, promotion or rollback authorities.
